rows.role_title: 代表 / 委員長 — representative of 公明党 and, until its December 1994 division, its chair (委員長)
rows.text: The party's history page says that 石田幸四郎委員長（当時） and three others from the old 公明党 joined the 細川 cabinet.

locator.paragraph: ＜自民党政権の転換の一翼も＞

rows.role_title: 代表 / 委員長 — representative of 公明党 and, until its December 1994 division, its chair (委員長)
rows.text: It says that the 新進党 was founded on １９９４年１２月１０日 under the slogan 「たゆまざる改革、責任ある政治の実現」.

locator.paragraph: ＜「公明」の発足と新進党結成へ参加＞

rows.role_title: 代表 / 委員長 — representative of 公明党 and, until its December 1994 division, its chair (委員長)
rows.text: It says that, to join it, the old 公明党 held a national convention on １９９４年１２月５日, closed its thirty-year history and decided the party's dissolution ('党の解散'), the formation of 「公明」 centred on local members and some Councillors and the founding of 「公明新党」 centred on Diet members, which 'それぞれ同日に発足'; 「公明新党」 took part in founding the 新進党.

locator.paragraph: ＜「公明」の発足と新進党結成へ参加＞

rows.role_title: 代表 / 委員長 — representative of 公明党 and, until its December 1994 division, its chair (委員長)
rows.text: It says that the 新進党 suddenly dissolved itself on １９９７年（平成９年）１２月２７日.

rows.role_title: 代表 / 委員長 — representative of 公明党 and, until its December 1994 division, its chair (委員長)
rows.text: It says that after the 新進党 dissolved, eighteen Councillors of the former 公明党 group formed 「黎明クラブ」 on the premise of joining 公明, most of the Representatives formed 「新党平和」, and three weeks later 「黎明クラブ」 merged with 「公明」.

locator.paragraph: ＜「大衆とともに」の原点に戻り、新しい公明党の誕生＞

rows.role_title: 代表 / 委員長 — representative of 公明党 and, until its December 1994 division, its chair (委員長)
rows.text: It says that on １９９８年（平成１０年）１１月７日 「公明」 and 「新党平和」 merged and the new, present 「公明党」 was formed ('新しい現在の「公明党」が結成されました').

locator.section: 新しい「公明党」の誕生と連立政権への参加
